description: Creates a tenant with a free key (tfr_free_…, shown once), or a free RPC key with its gateway URL and allowance. For reading an existing account use taifoon_account. Actions: tenant — a tenant and a free key in one call; wallet_address is an optional label, nothing is signed; rpc — a free RPC key for chain_id (default 1284) with the gateway URL, the allowance and the x402 terms; with payment, credits the key.

action.description: what to do (default tenant): tenant | rpc

agent_id.description: optional ERC-8004 id "<chain>:<id>" (a label on your tenant) (actions: tenant)

chain_id.description: the chain you want to read (default 1284 Moonbeam); the answer names its gateway URL (actions: rpc)

pay_chain_id.description: the pay chain of the transfer quote; absent = Base (actions: rpc)

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value (base64) for the accepts a previous call returned (actions: rpc)

tx.description: a settled subscribe payment whose credit was not written (actions: rpc)

wallet_address.description: optional: a 0x wallet address to label your tenant with (nothing is signed; leave it out) (actions: tenant)

name: taifoon_register
title: Get a key
